description: Monthly active subscribers · Jan–Jun 2026. A steady climb, with 56 new subscribers in June.

meta.prompt:
Create a responsive analytics card titled “Subscriber growth” with the muted eyebrow “Monthly active subscribers · Jan–Jun 2026”. Fill available width up to 576px. Use a theme-aware card surface, rounded border, an 18px title, a prominent 30px semibold metric with tabular numerals, and a separated muted footer.

Plot Jan–Jun subscribers 186, 225, 208, 284, 312, 368 as a single monotone 3px line without point dots. Label the tooltip series This year. Show 368 subscribers and a footer noting 56 new subscribers in June.

Keep the plot 260px tall and responsive to the card width. Provide accessible chart navigation and value tooltips. Use Jan–Jun month labels, a numeric vertical axis, dashed horizontal grid lines, and clean axes without tick marks or axis lines.
